subject: Redlines: Clearline renewal — term adjustment & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2024-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redlines: Clearline renewal — term adjustment & capacity uplift

Hi team,

Attaching the redline package we just got back from Clearline Legal. Key asks: they want a 14-month term instead of 12 (term shift tied to their fiscal close), and an immediate +30% capacity uplift on the first 6 months (phased billing). They also flagged Section 4.2 (Data retention) and asked for a narrower logging window.

Attachments: Clearline_Redlines_MSA.docx, OrderForm_v3.xlsx (see tab 'Billing')

Questions for legal (Markus): can we accept the 14-month term or do we need to counter with a 13-month compromise? Also want your take on the retention carve (they're asking for 30 days; our standard is 90).

Laura / Ben: customer is expecting a redline response and a proposed sign path by EOW (May 3). Can you confirm commercial flexibility for phased billing and the uplift pricing? If we need a credit for the term shift, flag it here.

Proposed next steps: 1) Legal marks up MSA with comments 2) Commercial approves price path for phased uplift 3) We send consolidated redline + DocuSign link to Clearline Legal.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Renewal Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Park <sam.park@clearline.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal-ops@clearline.com>
Date: 2024-04-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redlines: Clearline renewal — term adjustment & capacity uplift

Mina,

Thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 14-month term aligns with our procurement calendar; we can be flexible on billing cadence but need the contract effective through our FY end (June 30, 2025).
- The retention ask (30 days) is driven by our data governance for PII minimization. We can accept a 60-day compromise if you can provide documentation on how logs are isolated and purged.
- For the capacity uplift, we need the uplift enabled immediately but billing can be smoothed over Q1 of the term.

Our legal team will expect a consolidated redline (not piecemeal comments). If you can provide that plus an explanation of how fallbacks work if the uplift saturates reserved capacity, we can expedite sign.

I attached the internal summary we sent to procurement (not a formal doc): summary.pdf (not attached here)

Regards,
Sam Park
Sr. IT Procurement Manager | Clearline Systems
sam.park@clearline.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2024-04-30T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redlines: Clearline renewal — term adjustment & capacity uplift

Markus / Laura — forwarding Sam's note. Quick summary of what we need from you both before I re-send consolidated redline: 

- Markus: propose language for a 13-month counter (if we want to avoid agreeing to 14 months outright). Also, propose a one-paragraph appendix that documents our log retention and purge process (so we can offer 60 days with technical detail). We should call out that we retain aggregated usage metrics for 12 months for billing/analytics but purge request-level logs per retention window.
- Laura/Ben: confirm that we can do immediate +30% capacity activation with phased billing over 6 months and provide the updated ARR math (line items needed for the order form). If there's any discounting to concede for the term shift, say so.

Target: consolidated redline and updated order form back to Sam by COB May 2 so legal can route to procurement. If any blockers, escalate to me immediately.

Attached is a marked MSA with the following approach implemented: 13-month counter (Section 2.1), a 60-day log retention compromise with a short technical appendix detailing purge controls (new Exhibit G), and commentary footnotes where Clearline requested changes that materially increase our risk (we'll cover those in the cover email).

Commercials (Laura / Ben): I left placeholders for the billing schedule and credit for term shift — please fill those in the OrderForm_v3.xlsx and return it. Once both docs are consolidated, we'll send a single package to Sam with a short cover note and DocuSign link.

I ran the redline against our standard playbook; nothing here requires executive legal escalation but flag to me if you see new indemnity or data transfer language.
